resources.string: Start Shizuku first, then grant AIDE+ permission.

The assistant can inspect IDE errors, request and monitor the current build, compile individual Java/Kotlin sources, and run non-interactive Shell commands. Compiler and Shell jobs return IDs to check or cancel.\n\nApp Shell uses the app UID. Shizuku requires separate permission; shell UID is not root and cannot read app-private data. No automatic privilege fallback. Compiler outputs are isolated; individual compilation is not an APK build. Compiler cancellation is cooperative. Jobs do not survive app process death.

This tool executes code or controls a build, not just a file edit. Shell commands can access everything allowed to the chosen UID; the project working directory is not a filesystem sandbox. A managed build may install or launch the current project. Review the exact command, backend and arguments before allowing. “Always allow file changes” does not approve this tool.
